# Exhibit Graphic Sign (EGS)

> EGS is a Dubai-based production partner for high-stakes physical brand moments: custom exhibition stands, graduation ceremonies, event setups, retail branding rollouts, and branded commercial fitouts. Since 2010, EGS has been a trusted UAE operator specializing in pressure-tested execution when deadlines are fixed and specifications change.

## Core Navigation Map

- [Home Page](https://exhibitgraphicsign.com/): EGS positioning, core stats, and introductory services overview.
- [Exhibition Stands](https://exhibitgraphicsign.com/exhibitions): Custom stand design, carpentry, metalwork, and site build-up for major shows (GITEX, Arab Health, Gulfood, ADIPEC).
- [Events & Graduation Staging](https://exhibitgraphicsign.com/events): Full ceremony environments, stage carpentry, LED backdrops, audio-visual systems, and guest flow coordination.
- [Graduation Ceremony Portfolio](https://exhibitgraphicsign.com/graduation-portfolio): Technical specifications, stats, and media highlights for 25+ grand graduation ceremonies.
- [Retail Branding & Mall Kiosks](https://exhibitgraphicsign.com/retail): Multi-location FMCG store rollouts, custom product display stands, and after-hours mall activations.
- [Interior Fitouts & Branded Spaces](https://exhibitgraphicsign.com/fitouts): Branded reception lobbies, office signage, permanent kiosks, showroom joinery, and wayfinding.
- [Production Case Studies](https://exhibitgraphicsign.com/case-studies): Detailed breakdowns of high-stakes builds under tight timelines.

## Core Differentiators

- **Pressure-Tested Execution**: EGS becomes most valuable when the project plan changes late but the handover deadline does not move.
- **UAE-Wide Capability**: In-house fabrication, joinery, and large-format printing facilities, with transport and install crews operating across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Fujairah, Ras Al Khaimah, and Riyadh (KSA).
- **End-to-End Responsibility**: Design, structural engineering, production, logistics, site installation, Snag closure, and strike are managed under a single accountable team.

## Verified Case Studies (Proof Bank)

### 1. HCT Graduation Ceremony Program (Events & Graduations)
- **Context**: Seven consecutive years as a production partner for the Higher Colleges of Technology (HCT).
- **Scale**:
  - **2025**: Delivered 7 grand ceremonies across 5 emirates (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah) staging 4,500 graduates and 13,500 guests.
  - **2024**: Delivered 8 grand ceremonies staging 3,500 graduates and 10,000 guests.
- **Reference URL**: [HCT Case Studies](https://exhibitgraphicsign.com/case-studies#hct-graduation-program)

### 2. HCT Fujairah Staging (Urgent Event Adaptation)
- **Context**: Full stage build at Zayed Sports Complex.
- **The Pressure**: With 10 hours remaining before the ceremony, HCT requested an additional 5-6 metre stage extension for a photo display area.
- **The Action**: Sourced materials in Dubai, transported them to Fujairah, extended the carpentered wooden stage, carpeted it, and aligned it with existing sightlines.
- **Outcome**: Staging completed and ceremony delivered on time without visible modifications.
- **Reference URL**: [HCT Fujairah Case Study](https://exhibitgraphicsign.com/case-studies#hct-fujairah-stage-extension)

### 3. Sadia / Carrefour UAE Campaign (Retail Rollouts)
- **Context**: In-store chiller branding and island displays.
- **The Pressure**: Original launch scheduled for Friday. On Wednesday afternoon, the client moved the campaign forward to Thursday morning, leaving a single overnight window.
- **The Action**: Deployed 13 vehicles, 13 installers, and 8-10 QA/QC supervisors (25-30 people overall) starting at midnight post-closing.
- **Outcome**: Completed full branding across all 33 Carrefour hypermarket locations in the UAE before 6am opening.
- **Reference URL**: [Sadia Carrefour Case Study](https://exhibitgraphicsign.com/case-studies#sadia-carrefour-rollout)

### 4. Philips / Global Health Riyadh (Exhibition Adaptation)
- **Context**: 20m x 10m (200 sqm) healthcare exhibition stand in Riyadh, KSA.
- **The Pressure**: 10-12 hours before opening, the client requested a last-minute modification to integrate an ultrasound machine display.
- **The Action**: Fabricated a custom computer/TV display counter and integrated it seamlessly into the healthcare stand.
- **Outcome**: Delivered complete stand on time, incorporating both original branding and the new active product demo.
- **Reference URL**: [Philips Case Study](https://exhibitgraphicsign.com/case-studies#philips-global-health-riyadh)

### 5. Kazakhstan Pavilion / Gulfood (Exhibition Stands)
- **Context**: 28m x 6m (168 sqm) pavilion at Gulfood in Expo City Dubai.
- **The Pressure**: Close to opening, a last-minute exhibitor was added, requiring displays for meat and dairy products.
- **The Action**: Adapted the stand structure and added 5-6 branded product display chillers.
- **Outcome**: Completed setup before showtime, preserving the national pavilion design language.
- **Reference URL**: [Kazakhstan Pavilion Case Study](https://exhibitgraphicsign.com/case-studies#kazakhstan-pavilion-gulfood)

## Company Facts

- **Established**: 2010.
- **Production Facility**: 8,000 sqft joinery and fabrication hub in Sharjah, UAE.
- **Client Roster**: Philips, Higher Colleges of Technology (HCT), Schindler, Landmark Group, Serco, 800 Pizza, RAK American Academy, Fakhruddin Properties, Money Kicks.
- **Work Area**: UAE (All Emirates) and KSA (Riyadh/Jeddah).
